title: Adaptivity of the NPMLE to finitely discrete mixing distributions in Gaussian/Poisson mixtures
summary: We study the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) for Gaussian and Poisson mixture models, assuming the support of the true mixing distribution lies in a fixed bounded set. In this setting, we establish exact parametric rates for both, marginal density estimation and the posterior mean when the true mixing distribution is finitely discrete. Moreover, we show that the NPMLE attains the optimal demixing rate previously known for overparameterized finite mixture models.
